searchText: I'm going to open a PR for this today, <@586161934425128960> I **will not** address the issue that gossip in fact ignores any second slashing for blocks over gossip, I am afraid of removing that condition from P2P and would rather be lax and let clients cap that.. but perhaps this PR should remove that IGNORE or make it optional Here's the PR, left my own complains on it https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5644 already commented, don't need to ask me if you want to change anything or drop it entirely, just go ahead and edit there or just open a different one, this one seems alright to me except that perhaps I would want to remove the verification of the slashing in the helper as noted in the review and probably say something in the p2p spec about multiple slashings.
